name: Keurig Dr Pepper
description: Keurig Dr Pepper sells soft drinks (Dr Pepper, Canada Dry, 7UP, Snapple, Mott's, Core, GHOST energy) and coffee (Keurig brewers and K-Cup pods, Green Mountain Coffee Roasters). Its drinks business bottles and delivers its own brands through its own direct-store-delivery network and licenses concentrate to Coca-Cola and PepsiCo-affiliated bottlers. The coffee business sells brewers once, then earns on recurring pod sales. In April 2026 it bought about 98 percent of JDE Peet's (Jacobs, L'OR, Peet's) for about EUR 15.1 billion cash and plans a tax-free spin-off of its coffee business, combined with JDE Peet's, as a separate US-listed company in early 2027.

sub.name: Drinks (soft drinks, energy drinks, beer and spirits)

businessLines.name: U.S. Refreshment Beverages
businessLines.how: Manufactures drinks and concentrate; bottles and distributes through its own DSD network and licenses concentrate to bottlers affiliated with Coca-Cola, PepsiCo or independent; sold to retailers and food service; volume/mix contributed +9.0 points and net pricing +2.9 points to 2025 sales growth per the 10-K results table ; the GHOST acquisition alone added 6.2 of the 9.0 volume/mix points.
businessLines.description: Carbonated soft drinks, still drinks, energy (GHOST) and water brands made and sold in the US.

operatingProfit.note: Segment income from operations; FY2024 $1,878M; before $872M of unallocated corporate costs

businessLines.name: U.S. Coffee
businessLines.how: Razor and blade: Keurig brewers are sold to build the household base, then coffee pods are bought repeatedly; also sells to offices, hotels and convenience stores.
businessLines.description: Keurig single-serve brewers, K-Cup pods (Green Mountain Coffee Roasters, The Original Donut Shop), specialty and RTD coffee.

operatingProfit.note: Segment income from operations; FY2024 $1,079M; before $872M of unallocated corporate costs

businessLines.name: International
businessLines.how: Branded drinks sold through its own and third-party distribution; margin 25.1% vs 26.5%.
businessLines.description: Beverages and coffee in Canada, Mexico and other markets (Peafiel is among the brands named).
